description:
As the managing editor, set up the content pipeline for the upcoming weeks. Create three posts assigned to different team members with specific scheduling:

1. Title: 'Q1 2026 Revenue Analysis'
   - Author: editor (user 'editor' already exists)
   - Category: News
   - Schedule for publication: March 15, 2026 at 9:00 AM
   - Must contain at least 50 words of relevant content about quarterly revenue

2. Title: 'Spring Product Launch Preview'
   - Author: author (user 'author' already exists)
   - Category: Technology
   - Schedule for publication: March 20, 2026 at 10:00 AM
   - Must contain at least 50 words of relevant content about product launches

3. Title: 'Annual Team Building Event Recap'
   - Author: contributor (user 'contributor' already exists)
   - Category: Lifestyle
   - Status: Pending Review (do NOT publish or schedule)
   - Must contain at least 50 words of relevant content about a team event

All three users (editor, author, contributor) already exist in the system. Each post must be assigned to the correct author, placed in the correct category, and have the appropriate scheduling or status.
